summary.text: Dick Campbell is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 19 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Campbell, listed by Ballotpedia as Richard Campbell, has represented District 19 since 2022 and earlier served in the House from 2012 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Dick Campbell lives in Orrington, Maine, graduated from Brewer High School, and served in the Maine Air National Guard during the Vietnam War, according to Ballotpedia, which lists him as Richard Campbell.
His career experience includes owning Dick Campbell LLC, and he has served as president of the Bangor-Brewer YMCA Board of Trustees and as co-chair of the Eastern Maine Soapbox Derby.
Campbell represented Maine House District 130 from 2012 to 2020 and has represented District 19 since 2022, succeeding Matthew Harrington.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as the Ethics Committee and the Rules and Business of the House Committee, where he is ranking member.
David Ulrich is the Democratic candidate against him in 2026.
